import pytest
from browser_use.llm.openai.serializer import OpenAIMessageSerializer
from browser_use.llm.messages import BaseMessage

class DummyMessage(BaseMessage):
    pass

def test_unknown_message_type_logs_error(caplog):
    dummy = DummyMessage()
    caplog.set_level(logging.ERROR)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unknown message type"):
        OpenAIMessageSerializer.serialize(dummy)
    # Ensure an error log was emitted with the expected message
    error_logs = [record for record in caplog.records if record.levelno == logging.ERROR]
    assert any('Unknown message type' in record.getMessage() for record in error_logs), "Expected error log for unknown message type"
